affected_subject.reason: Identifies getImpactPrice, _getQuoteLimit/_getBaseLimit in Book.sol and markPrice computation as affected components.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete attack path: place short-expiry buy wall, let it expire, market crash, setMarkPrice triggers getImpactPrice simulation counting ghost orders.

direct_effect.reason: Expired orders counted as liquidity, artificially high impactBid inflates markPrice, preventing liquidation.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected markPrice reflects real tradeable liquidity; actual includes expired orders, violating the impact-price safety relation.

summary: Report explains affected functions, concrete attack trigger, direct markPrice manipulation effect, and the expected-vs-actual liquidity safety relation, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
